listing.name: Infinite Fuel
listing.abstract: Keeps your vehicle's tanks full, even while the engines burn. Toggle it in the Mods menu.
listing.description:
Turn on **Mods > Infinite Fuel** and the vehicle you control never runs dry: its tanks are topped up every frame, during burns too. Click it again to turn it off. A check mark shows while it is on, and the setting is remembered between sessions. It starts off.

Needs [Oxidizer](https://github.com/SafeShows/Oxidizer) (StarMap or standalone).

**Limits**
- Only the vehicle you control is refilled.
- Every tank is refilled, life support gases included, not only propellant.
